description: A React functional component demonstrating the usage of AzureTextModerationConfiguration component, managing state for text moderation categories, thresholds, and handling user interactions such as save and reset actions.

methods.name: handleCategorySelect
methods.description: Handles toggling of categories in the selectedCategories state.

methods.name: handleGlobalSeverityChange
methods.description: Updates the global severity threshold state.

methods.name: handleCategorySeverityChange
methods.description: Updates the severity threshold for a specific category.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Constructs the current configuration object and logs it, also displays a success notification.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets configuration states to default values and shows an info notification.
